cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: Only the Year-End box is checked; the amendment 'No' box is checked. Signed 1/20/14, clerk stamp JAN 31 2014. All four Line 1 / Line 2 money cells are prefixed with a hand-drawn dollar sign whose cursive stroke can look like a strike-through at low resolution - re-rendered at 300 dpi to confirm it is a '$', not a struck-out digit. Line 1 Column A additionally carries a thousands separator ('7,595.78') that the other three cells omit ('7595.78'); its separators are written loosely and could be read as commas in both positions, hence medium confidence on that one cell. Lines 4, 5 and 6 read 7595.78 without a dollar sign; lines 3 and 7 are hand-drawn open zeros. Arithmetic checks: 0 + 7,595.78 = 7,595.78 and 7,595.78 - 7,595.78 = 0.
